incident_spec.summary: Stored procedure enters an infinite loop after index updates, potentially due to page locking or trigger behavior.
symptoms: Infinite looping occurs when an update statement is executed inside an insert trigger.
incident_spec.mechanism: Page locking on an index combined with nested cursors and triggers causes infinite looping and deadlocks.
